examples.arabic: العيلة كانت مبسوطة تاني بعد كده.
examples.english: The family was happy again after that.
examples.transliteration: El 3eila kanet mabsoota tani ba3d keda.

examples.english: A little while, the ball came out again.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: انا هرد على التليفون و ارجع تاني
examples.english: I will answer the phone and return again
examples.transliteration: ana haradd ala el tilifoun wa argaa tani

examples.arabic: فرحت اوي وقلت الحمد لله اننا اتقابلنا تاني
examples.english: I was very happy and said praise to God that we met again.
examples.transliteration: feraht awi we olt el hamd lelah enena etabelna tany

examples.arabic: سأل تاني إمتى هو كمان هيروح المدرسة وإمتى هيخلص لعب
examples.english: He asked again, "When will he also go to school and when will he finish playing?"
examples.transliteration: Sa'al taany emta howwa kamaan hayrouh elmadrasa weemta hayekhallas la'b.

examples.arabic: انا قولت يلا بينا نلعب تاني
